name: Explain_8
short_caption: The robot opens its arms outward with open palms to explain a concept.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral pose and smoothly raises both arms forward, turning its palms upward and spreading its hands slightly outward. Its head remains centered, facing the viewer with a neutral posture. Finally, it slowly retracts its arms and hands back down to the default resting position at its sides.
safety_notes: The arms extend forward and slightly outward; ensure a clear envelope of about 30 cm in front of the robot.
